cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I turned my bracket over like you did, then fitted it. Now the shelf's down. They must have supplied the wrong shape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I turned mine to read the label. You fitted yours upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Label checked, yes. It should have an arrow showing which way to fit it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It does. You painted over it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An arrow that disappears under paint isn't safe. Photograph it for the manufacturer.

reason: Make copied inspection position cause installation error; new evidence about A painted arrow drives more revealing manufacturer blame.
